purpose: Fresh non-parent canary for the current frontier blocker. Prove that the canonical ASTRA mission entrypoint propagates a real origin mission path into autonomous PyPI acquisition before any fresh parent task is frozen.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY_SOURCE.json containing exactly three records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma. Using a Python library from PyPI discovered by the Brain, encode those exact records as CBOR and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY.cbor. Independently decode the CBOR artifact and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.

constraints.acceptance: Origin mission path must be canonical and non-empty; APT_ORIGIN_MISSION_PATH_INVALID and PYPI_ORIGIN_MISSION_PATH_INVALID are forbidden terminal causes.
